market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: The market-implied probability of 1.1% is far too low for any team in a 10-team league; even the weakest competitor has at least a few percent chance to win. KKR won the IPL in 2024 and retains a core of experienced players, so their true chance is likely in the 8–10% range. The large discrepancy gives a strong signal to bet Yes.
evidence_points: 10-team league implies a naive baseline of ~10% per team.
KKR won the IPL in 2024 and has retained key players (Russell, Narine, Rinku Singh).
Bookmakers typically price KKR in the 8-12% range for upcoming IPL seasons.
sources_consulted: general IPL winner odds from sportsbooks
